'''Stage IV Dispatchers''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Nexus Parasites|Nexus]] Tier.

They are one of the [[Bosses]] of the Mod and will grant players the {{AdvancementLink|Qliphoth Overload}} when alive. Killing one will grant the {{AdvancementLink|ALEPH Suppression}}.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawned after a [[Stage III Dispatcher]] evolves.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Stage IV Dispatchers are Colony Constructors and Stationary Offensive Support Parasites.
*Stage IV Dispatchers can store and teleport parasites around using [[Dispatcher Tentacle|Dispatcher Tentacles]], Stage IV Dispatchers can summon up to 12. Parasites that have been stored by a Dispatcher that despawn will end up back in the Dispatcher's storage.
**[[Buglin|Buglins]] stored by Stage IV Dispatchers will become [[Rupter|Rupters]].
**[[Rupter|Rupters]] stored by Stage IV Dispatchers will become [[Mangler|Manglers]].
**4 [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Mobs]] stored by Stage IV Dispatchers will become a [[:Category:Primitive Parasites|Primitive]].
**[[Incomplete Forms]] stored by a Stage IV Dispatcher reaching 6 value (with [[Small Incomplete Form|Small]] having a value of 1 and [[Medium Incomplete Form|Medium]] having a value of 2) will create a [[Crux]].
*Stage IV Dispatchers can summon up to 9 [[Seizer|Seizers]] and [[Sentry|Sentries]] to defend them.
*Stage IV Dispatchers can summon multiple Ancient Pods, which will fall from the sky towards the ground. Few seconds after landing, they will explode inflicting 50 damage, release a Toxic Cloud giving Saturation -20 for 10 seconds and release and effect cloud of Poison for 15 seconds. Ancient Pods from a Stage IV Dispatcher will not spawn any parasites. It must wait at least 12 seconds before it can summon Pods again, and a maximum of 5 can spawn.
*Stage IV Dispatchers will force nearby [[Assimilated Mobs]] to drop their disguise (unless if they are on water).
*Starting from [[Ubiquitous Development]] Level 4, Stage IV Dispatchers will be able to generate [[Colony|Colonies]].
*Stage IV Dispatchers throw 8 bombs around them when damaged, this has a cooldown of 5 seconds. These bombs inflict 22 damage each and place an effect cloud of [[Viral]] and Poison.
*Stage IV Dispatchers can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 18, with a 20 ticks cooldown and 5 Blocks range.
*Stage IV Dispatchers will apply the following effects to parasites:
**Speed III (6:40)
**Regeneration IV (6:40)
**Strength IV (6:40)
**Absorption IV (6:40)
**[[Debar]] I (6:40)
**[[Link]] III (8:20)
**[[Heightened Senses]] IV (6:40)
* Upon death, if at least one [[Colony]] is present in the dimension, Stage IV Dispatchers will become [[Stage III Dispatcher|Stage III Dispatchers]].

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
* Stage IV Dispatchers, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
** Any entities a Dispatcher summons will also be on fire. (Note that fire is not enough to outright kill their tentacles).

* The top most flower on the Stage IV Dispatcher functions as a Weak Point. When this Weak Point is hit, damage inflicted to it is tripled and the [[Bleeding]] Effect is applied to it.
* Right clicking on any of their Dispatcher Tentacles or Seizers will apply the glowing effect to their Dispatcher.

== ''Trivia''==
* Like all Nexues, Stage IV Dispatchers do not despawn.
* Stage IV Dispatchers are also known as '''DodSIV''' in the Mod Files.
* In the early builds of [[Version 1.9.6|1.9.6]], Dispatchers used to be called ‘’’Reinforcers’’’.
* The achievement associated with the Dispatcher IV '''[Qliphoth Overload]''' is a reference to the indie game ''Lobotomy Corp'' by PROJECT MOON
